title: A quiet move can be brilliant
subtitle: Hikaru · Chess.com labels 27.Bg2 Brilliant
captions: 27.Bg2 leaves the rook on b1 available to Black’s bishop.
If Black plays ...Bxb1, the bishop takes that rook.
28.Rxb1 recaptures the bishop: White trades a rook for a bishop.
line_label: After 27.Bg2, ...Bxb1 Rxb1 is a conditional illustration.

title: An offer that finishes a pawn up
label: Excellent
captions: Black takes a pawn and offers a knight.
A pawn takes the second knight.
The rook takes a bishop on another square.
conclusion: Two knights for a knight and bishop. Black gains one pawn.
subtitle: Chess.com: Excellent · material comparison
line_label: Conditional capture sequence; these replies are not forced.

title: A similar exchange receives Brilliant
label: Brilliant
captions: Black takes a pawn and offers a knight.
A bishop recaptures the white knight.
The other bishop takes a bishop elsewhere.
conclusion: A knight and bishop for a knight and bishop. One pawn gained.
subtitle: Chess.com: Brilliant · material comparison
line_label: Conditional capture sequence; these replies are not forced.
